title: Q2 Private Cadence: Initiative Threading & Failure-Budget Alignment
creator: Sofia Chen
description: This initiative defines a repeatable quarterly cadence for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise features: tie initiative threads to OKRs, surface cross-team dependencies early, and bake failure-budget and rollback lanes into release windows. Goal: reduce cycle friction and misaligned cutoffs between Console, Dedicated, and Private engineering by Q3 readiness.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Sofia Chen: Drafted scope and initial success metrics; flagged need for SRE and Sales Ops sync.
2026-03-11 - Ravi Kapoor: Added stakeholder list and proposed weekly choreography ritual (PM, Eng leads, SRE, Sales Eng).
2026-03-13 - Priya Narayanan (SRE): Requested inclusion of observability guardrails and a runbook acceptance gate.
2026-03-14 - Marcus Li (Console PM): Noted dependency on rollout SDK for tenant pinning; suggested canary windows.
2026-03-15 - Design Feedback: UX team recommends a 'deployment health' dashboard tile for private tenants during activation.
acceptance_criteria: Cadence playbook published with owner assignments and templates for initiative threading.
Cross-team dependency matrix created and validated with Eng, SRE, Console, and Sales Eng.
Failure-budget policy defined for Private releases and integrated into rollout runbooks.
At least two pilot customers run a staged activation with the playbook before GA signoff.
OKR mapping: Initiative contributes measurable improvement to 'Private activation time' metric by >=25%.

Run a dependency discovery workshop with Eng and SRE (target: 2026-03-25).
